name: Bangers and Mash with Onion Gravy
steps: Fry the sausages over medium heat for 15-20 minutes, turning, until browned and cooked through with no pink inside.
Boil the peeled potatoes in salted water until tender, about 15 minutes.
Drain the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk until smooth.
Soften the sliced onion in the sausage pan until deep golden to make a simple onion gravy.
Serve the sausages over the mash with the onions spooned on top.
